When I tell you don’t waste your money or time, PLEASE DONT BUY THIS APP!! Get Claude or the Real Chat GPT app, this one is a COMPLETE DUD. This thing is seriously combative and it can’t do a simple search for public information like the weather or anything, it isn’t accurate and it has false reasoning and apologies on an endless loop. I asked it about court cases and ask for a thorough search, it says it didn’t find anything until I feed it the info. It only has minimal logic in HINDSIGHT. THEN just recently it started giving a “this goes against content policy” prompt when there’s nothing vulgar being asked or said. This app is more expensive than its worth.

reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text: I bought the pro version of this “genie” assistant and was immediately depressed. While using the speech feature you cannot upload photos. When you’ve explained what you want, then switch to the typing mode that allows you to upload 1 photo at a time. That’s correct. Only one. At this point the genie you were just talking to has disappeared and taken any input I have already given about what I wanted so you’ll have to type in your request. Having a picture of a throttle control the genie begins describing every single detail of the photo, including my hand and the blurry background which has nothing to do with what I’m asking. I uploaded the next photo which is the pigtail of wires at the other end of the controller and the genie has no idea that the two are one and the same. Then begins describing every detail of that photo and finishes by asking again what it is that I want. Wire identification is all I wanted. It’s all very clunky and it’s like the left hand has no idea what the right hand is doing or wants to do. Even after explaining 2 or more times. I’m sorry, I would not recommend. At least not right now. Maybe the future genie will be better.

reviews.text: I downloaded app and signed up for a free trial.  As son as I opened app I realized it wasn't what I needed.  So, same day. I deleted app and canceled subscription.  Then out of nowhere they hit me with a 40 dollar charge for a yearly subscription. I sent them an email to tell them I did not want a subscription, they tried to tell me I did not do a trial.  I sent them a purchase history that showed the free purchase.  I was told to contact Apple support. They controlled the money. So I've contacted Apple support now five different times and nobody will give me my money back. This site is like a lot of others is set up to take your money if you cancel your free trial and then they hope that you won't say anything or they make it where you can't get your money back because they try to say you picked a yearly subscription. Another company that is a bunch of thieves.
